about_the_game:
This game currently supports Japanese only.

The user interface, in-game text, and screenshots are all displayed in Japanese.

English language support is not available at this time.

The battlefield is quiet, yet it constantly and inevitably changes its shape.

Tank Rogue is a strategic action game that blends tank combat with roguelike elements.
You take control of a single tank and push through sterile, abstract battlefields built from simple structures.

But this battlefield is far from forgiving.
A wide variety of gimmicks and enemies with distinct behaviors surround you from every direction.

Throughout battle, you acquire Modules that enhance and transform your tank.
What to take, what to abandon, and how to use limited resources.
Each decision directly affects your chances of survival.

With every victory, your tank grows stronger, and the battlefield becomes increasingly intense and complex.
Relying solely on the resources you are given will not be enough to survive until the end.
In a world without order, the most reliable weapon is the player’s own skill and judgment.

Key Features

Roguelike Structure
Stages, enemies, and module drops change every run, creating a different combat scenario each time.

Module Collection and Customization
By combining modules, your combat style fundamentally changes. Build a tank that fits your strategy.

Unique Enemies and Gimmicks
Despite their abstract appearance, enemies and battlefields demand varied tactics and adaptability.

Happening Events
Sudden events that can benefit or hinder you, depending on the choices you make.

Abstract and Quiet World
Minimalistic visuals and effects create a tense, restrained atmosphere on the battlefield.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Tank Rogue is a strategic action game that combines tank combat with roguelike elements. Control a single tank and break through ever-changing battlefields using limited resources. Your choice of modules drastically alters your playstyle, making skill and decision-making the key to survival.
